title: Mira Iyer：一次加息无伤大雅，但工资无压力为何要动？
speaker: Mira Iyer

segments.en: So one rate hike is not a problem at all. 25 basis points change in funding costs for economies is largely not meant. No one changes their behavior because there's 25 basis points more expensive.
segments.zh: 一次加息根本不是问题。25个基点的融资成本变动对经济影响不大，没有人会因为贵了25个基点就改变行为。

segments.en: Now, if it's 1% or 2% more expensive, that's a different story. But our sense is if they do anything, it'll be 25 basis points kind of an insurance hike just to show that they've done something you're on inflation.
segments.zh: 但如果贵了1%或2%，那就另当别论。我们的感觉是，即便加息，也只会是25个基点的“保险式”加息，表明他们对通胀有所行动。

segments.en: But I would question why it's needed. You have no wage pressure. No wage inflation pressure whatsoever. The easiest argument maybe is that AI threats are making very difficult for employees to ask for raises.
segments.zh: 但我质疑其必要性。根本没有工资压力，没有工资通胀压力。最简单的解释或许是，AI威胁让员工很难要求加薪。
